entries.en: VSCode Extension: Added setting to configure the initial permission mode for new conversations
entries.zh: VS Code 扩展：新增设置，可配置新对话的初始权限模式

entries.en: Improved file path suggestion performance with native Rust-based fuzzy finder
entries.zh: 改进文件路径建议的性能：使用基于 Rust 的原生模糊查找器

entries.en: Fixed infinite token refresh loop that caused MCP servers with OAuth (e.g., Slack) to hang during connection
entries.zh: 修复了导致具有 OAuth（例如 Slack）的 MCP 服务器在连接期间挂起的无限令牌刷新循环

entries.en: Fixed memory crash when reading or writing large files (especially base64-encoded images)
entries.zh: 修复了读取或写入大文件（尤其是 base64 编码的图像）时的内存崩溃问题
